limits: Selected sample from ten screened books; seven unique assets are not seven proved independent camera settings.
One repeated source occurrence excluded from unique-image summaries. Many cap thresholds yield partial samples; all failures retained.
Official camera residuals are descriptive. The same method is not sufficiently accurate on synthetic rasters to infer exact angle differences.
Higher-resolution native controls are newly rasterized PDFs, not interpolated official JPEGs.
No universal p-value, exact FOV, or theme-specific camera preset follows from this batch.
